test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Cotton clothes are preferred in summer season because:

options.text: cotton is unable to expose sweat to the atmosphere for evaporation
cotton is a bad absorber of water and exposes sweat to atmosphere for evaporation
cotton is a good absorber of water and exposes sweat to atmosphere for evaporation

solution:
The correct answer is __**cotton is a good absorber of water and exposes sweat to atmosphere for evaporation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Cotton fabric** is highly breathable, allowing air to circulate around the skin and sweat to evaporate.
 
• Cotton is a **natural fiber** known for its ability to absorb moisture effectively.
 
• When sweat is absorbed by cotton, it exposes a larger surface area for **evaporation**, which helps in cooling the body.
 
• Evaporation of sweat from cotton clothes results in a cooling effect on the body, making it a preferred choice for summer wear.
 
• Cotton’s moisture-wicking properties help in maintaining body temperature and prevent overheating during hot weather.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Evaporation Process**

 
 
• Evaporation is the process by which water changes from a liquid to a gas or vapor.
 
• This process requires heat energy, which is taken from the surroundings, resulting in a cooling effect.
 
• The efficiency of evaporation increases with higher temperatures and lower humidity levels.
 
 
 
• **Breathable Fabrics**
 
 
• Fabrics like cotton, linen, and some synthetic materials are designed to be breathable.
 
• Breathable fabrics allow air to pass through them, aiding in moisture wicking and temperature regulation.
 
• Such fabrics are ideal for active wear and hot weather clothing.
 
 
 
• **Moisture-Wicking**
 
 
• Moisture-wicking refers to the ability of a fabric to pull moisture away from the skin to the fabric's outer surface.
 
• This helps in quicker evaporation and keeps the body dry and comfortable.
 
• It is a key feature in athletic and performance clothing.
 
 
 
• **Thermal Regulation**
 
 
• Thermal regulation is the process by which the body maintains its core internal temperature.
 
• Proper clothing can assist in thermal regulation by providing insulation and aiding in heat dissipation.
 
• Cotton helps in maintaining thermal comfort by allowing heat to escape and sweat to evaporate.
